citation: Messager, M.L., Lehner, B., Grill, G., Nedeva, I., Schmitt, O. (2016). Estimating the volume and age of water stored in global lakes using a geo-statistical approach. Nature Communications 7: 13603. doi:10.1038/ncomms13603
scale: shorelines of every lake and reservoir of 10 ha or more
ours: The colours and the size bands: lakes under 1,000 km2 are left out of zooms 0-2, under 50 km2 out of 3-4 and under 2 km2 out of 5-6, because they are under a pixel there. Everything else is HydroLAKES'.
format: Mapbox Vector Tile, layer: lakes, Web Mercator XYZ — the scheme mvt.js computes tile bounds on
note: Baked by GeoID_GIS/services/bake-hydrology.py from the source archives mirrored under shapefiles/ in R2. There is no remote behind this pyramid: past max_zoom there are no tiles.
